notes.title: 0.7 Update
notes.content: [p]Hi all! Kind of a small update, in preparation of a much bigger one later. We're putting to test 2 new mechanics that will be the building blocks of a future "meta-game" based on the Village, buildings, characters and quests.[/p][p]Those mechanics are:[/p][list][*][p]Every item has now up to 3 materials that can be salvaged by trashing the item (or when the game is over). For now it has no use except to show off in the mountain map, but later those resources will be used in the Village to unlock new buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]4 quests are implemented, one is chosen randomly for now, but later those quests will be given by characters to unlock new features.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also we've started to work on a cleaner UI in preparation for the upcoming Demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/33b1d9393fae8f1edb296d059a91c4e014e43c82.png"][/img][/p][p]It's kind of a "dev/preview" build but any feedback is welcome, here or on our Discord server! Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.content: [p]Update 0.6 is in![/p][p][/p][h3]Object Art[/h3][p]We implemented all the missing art for the objects we wanted for the upcoming demo! We hope you'll enjoy this nice addition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/1b7fab6b31e5d5ac0a5a75271bfd173f54e2f693.png"][/img]From now on and until we release our first official demo in october, we'll host object creation contest on our social networks and our [url="https://discord.gg/kAQXzQJMGm"]Discord[/url]! Join in to give us your ideas! The first winner is a delicious Chocolat Bar:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/29c4b7d18f1e820f194a4a6cfc1df638b191e7f3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Events[/h3][p]In some regions you'll notice new information about effects that take place when you're there. Beware![/p][h3]Health Update[/h3][p]We reworked how Life Points are lost to avoid abrupt game over. Let us know what you think![/p][h3]Anomalies[/h3][p]Some items (such as the chocolate) come from another timeline and are obtained by interacting by Anomalies in the world. Can you find all of these technologically advanced objects?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/332d17e12cac473448c4a9337e5869d6901e2658.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 0.4 Content Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597175/231a23da24945c5450be944981b2d025be16be82.png"][/img][/p][p]Happy to introduce a new game-changing feature: the Mountain Map![/p][p]It will allow your travel to be more tactical and awesome.[/p][p][b]Let us know what you think![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, a bunch of fixes and QoL, including:[/p][list][*][p]New "shake bag" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Game altitude is now display on game over screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.3 Update
notes.content:
- 3 new zone prototypes! Merchant (will trade items for their value), Fire Camp (throw items in the fire to get bonuses), and Boss (a big enemy with several life points). Tell us what you think!
- We reworked how the mountain and the environmnent are made, so the overall visual quality has improved
- Many bug have been fixed
- Global difficulty balance
